function varargout = qpOASES_sequence(command, varargin)
persistent commands failAfterUpdate;
switch command
    case 'testResetTrace'
        commands = '';
        failAfterUpdate = false;
        return;
    case 'testCommands'
        varargout = {commands};
        return;
    case 'testFailAfterUpdate'
        failAfterUpdate = true;
        return;
end

commands = [commands, command];
if nargout == 0
    qpOASES_sequence_trace_native(command, varargin{:});
else
    [varargout{1:nargout}] = qpOASES_sequence_trace_native(command, varargin{:});
end
if strcmp(command, 'm') && failAfterUpdate
    assert(varargout{3} == 0, 'The native matrix update must succeed before fault injection.');
    varargout{3} = 1;
    failAfterUpdate = false;
end
end
